reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a material, localized repair composition, processing limits, quantitative outcomes, matched baselines, and decisive falsification thresholds while extending prior HEA-coating results to repair of Cr–Ni–Mo steel. Its claim that rapid cooling lowers thermal stress is oversimplified and laser cladding can itself hot-crack, but preheating and confined heat input make the mechanism more testable and the proposal substantially better defined than A’s vague FSP treatment, which may not restore lost geometry and lacks quantitative conditions or outcomes.
